stories.title: Eala Beats Svitolina 6-3, 6-4 — DC Open WTA Semifinalist vs. Osaka
stories.angle: FOLLOW-UP (July 30 Story 1) — Alexandra Eala (Philippines, No. 28, unseeded) defeated No. 10 Elina Svitolina 6-3, 6-4 in the DC Open WTA quarterfinals on Friday July 31, advancing to the semifinals at Washington. The win repeated the exact score Eala posted against Svitolina in Berlin earlier in the season. Eala now faces No. 3 seed Naomi Osaka in the SF on Saturday August 1. In sequence: Eala has now defeated Zheng (R1), Fernandez (R2, defending champion), and Svitolina (QF) to reach the final four. She remains unseeded and ranked No. 28.

stories.title: DC Open ATP QF — Nakashima Upsets No. 1 De Minaur; Tabilo Ousts Shelton; Jodar Into Top 20
stories.angle: FOLLOW-UP (July 30 Story 2) — Earthquake results in the DC Open ATP quarterfinals on Friday July 31. Brandon Nakashima (USA) eliminated top seed and defending champion Alex de Minaur 7-6(5), 6-4. Alejandro Tabilo (CHI) upset No. 2 seed Ben Shelton. Rafael Jodar (ESP, 19) defeated No. 6 seed Lorenzo Musetti 1-6, 6-1, 6-4. Taylor Fritz (3, USA) was the only top-four seed to survive, advancing via a comeback from match point down against Alex Michelsen. Semifinals today (August 1): Nakashima vs. Fritz; Jodar vs. Tabilo. Jodar will crack the ATP Top 20 regardless of his semifinal result.

stories.title: Los Cabos Final — Shapovalov vs. Gea; French 21-Year-Old Earns First ATP Final
stories.angle: FOLLOW-UP (July 30 Story 4) — The Mifel Tennis Open final is set at Los Cabos, Mexico. Denis Shapovalov (CAN, 8) defeated No. 5 seed Cameron Norrie 6-3, 5-7, 6-4 in the semifinals. Arthur Gea (FRA, 21, ranked No. 127) defeated Coleman Wong 7-6(7), 6-3 in the other semifinal, reaching his first-ever ATP Tour final. Gea will break into the Top 100 regardless of the final result. Shapovalov is a past Los Cabos champion and in his second final at the tournament. Final: Saturday August 1.

stories.title: Canadian Open Draws Set — Pegula No. 1 WTA Toronto; Zverev No. 1 ATP Montreal; Draper Wildcard
